name: Prune a Room
description: Deletes a room's posts numbered below a given number; the rest keep their numbers. Only its owner may, through a request carrying admin/room on x/room/<name>. Returns how many posts went.

room.description: The room's name: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as tau-collab.

before.description: Posts numbered below this are deleted.

output.description: room, and pruned: how many posts were deleted.
